tips: Cowry card: needed for BRT, Blue Line, Red Line and LAGFERRY. Buy one at any BRT terminal or rail station (about ₦600–₦1,000) and top up ₦100–₦5,000.
Danfo: pay the conductor in cash, ideally exact change, and confirm the destination the conductor is shouting before you board.
Rush hours: 6–9am towards the Island and 4–8pm back to the mainland — add 30–60 minutes.
Last mile: keke costs about ₦200–₦800 depending on distance. Okada is banned on major roads in many Lagos LGAs.
